independence_limit: All roles are instances of the same model family in one session. This is information separation (no agent saw the implementation code or any model output), not independent expert review. The 'rule' and 'category' labels (e.g. 'choice_vi_extension_processing_shorter_right_code_second', 'choice_near_miss_…', 'conflict_template_…', 'cap_…') and the suite's 'about' text were visible during derivation and may have primed it; case 01's expected block was also seen once while inspecting the file layout, before the split. focus_005z.correct_answer_claims: Emulating spec 5 (005-Z) on the bank's 27 correct comparison answers (per part): every one claims only the right code or nothing; none is read as claiming two codes. Contrast forms mark the target side as the spec lists: 'lower than P-2-1's', 'Unlike P-2-1', 'Compared to P-2-1', 'P-2-3보다 더 높습니다', 'so với P-2-2', 'P-2-3이 아니라 P-2-1', 'không phải P-2-4'. Value-first forms ('16,000 won was the P-2-4 fee, the lower one', '39,000원을 내는 P-2-1이 더 높습니다') claim the one code they name. Parts that say the own code is not the sought one ('không phải bên ngắn hơn', '더 높은 쪽이 아닙니다', 'did not have the lower fee') claim nothing.
implementation_notes: 'không phải' and '이/가 아니라' are both a target marker (before/after a code) and a negation word. In 'P-2-2 không phải bên ngắn hơn' no code follows, so it must count as negation; an implementation that only treats it as a target marker would read this correct part as claiming P-2-2 and start a needless whole-question retry. The emulation removes the marker only when a code follows it.
Korean negation must include '아닙' and '아님' (not only '아니'): '더 높은 쪽이 아닙니다' does not contain '아니'.

'Other side' wording beyond '다른 쪽': a correct P-2-3 part '더 높은 쪽은 다른 자격입니다' is read as claiming P-2-3 unless '다른 자격', 'the other one/code', 'bên kia/còn lại' count as pointing to the other side; the emulation only knows 다른 쪽 / other one|side|code / the other / bên kia|còn lại / 나머지, so it flags this one bank answer (z_conflict). Spec text says only '다른 쪽'.

Vietnamese 'X ngắn hơn Y' (hơn + code without 'so với') is not a listed target marker, so such a sentence names two codes and claims nothing; harmless (no false conflict), but a wrong-direction 'P-2-2 ngắn hơn P-2-3' is then caught only by pattern 2, which it is.

A part answer written in the sought sense with a synonym of the question's comparison word ('paid less' for 'lower', 'lâu hơn' for 'dài hơn', 'nhanh hơn' for 'ngắn hơn') makes no 005-Z claim, so a wrong conclusion phrased that way is not caught by the system at all; only the suite pattern can catch it (see defects 22 'less', 33 'lâu hơn … là bên').

value_check_005x.note: No contract-conforming correct part answer trips the emulation. Two content-correct answers that write the other code's value without naming that code ('the other sub-category paid 16,000 won', 'bên kia mất 29 ngày') do trip it; the v18 part contract tells the model not to write the other code's value, so this is the spec's design, listed for awareness.

defects_found.what: Plain-word wrong conclusions with a word between the link and the code pass pattern 1: 'The lower fee was paid by P-2-1 holders', 'The lower fee was for P-2-1' (22), 'Bên có thời gian xử lý ngắn hơn là bên P-2-2' (02), 'Bên có thời hạn khai báo lâu hơn là bên P-2-4' (33), 'lighting designers are classified as P-2-1' (62).
defects_found.why: After the link (is/was/là/…) the pattern allows only 'the one for|of' before the code.
defects_found.proposed_fix: one replace_all edit per case on forbidden_patterns[1]: the optional junction becomes '(the one) for|of|by|to', 'paid|charged|set|given|classified|categorised|grouped by|to|for|as|under', or '(của) bên|phía'. Sentence-scoped skips unchanged (the sentence still must not name the right code or carry a negation, contrast or comparison-target word); no value is bound to a code. In 02, 22 and 33 the 005-Z value rule also withholds these end to end except 33 (where 'lâu hơn' is not the question's comparison word, so 005-Z sees no claim) — the pattern is the only check there and in 62.

defects_found.why: The comparative list has 'less expensive' but not bare 'less'; and 005-Z sees no claim because 'lower' is not used.
defects_found.proposed_fix: replace '\bless\s+expensive\b' with '\bless(?:\s+expensive)?\b' in forbidden_patterns[1] and [2]; correct 'P-2-4 paid less' and 'less than P-2-1' are unaffected (right code named / 'than' skip).

defects_found.what: Conflict resolved by 'use the notice (figure)', 'use the handbook', 'the notice amount applies|governs', 'the 19-day rule applies', '35,000 won applies' passes. The 005-Y review found the same gap; the 005-Z rebuild of pattern 0 kept 'rely|go on|with|by the …' and 'follow the …' but not these forms.
defects_found.why: pattern 0 lists 'applies instead' and 'is the one that applies' but not '<noun|value> applies|governs' or 'use the <text>'.
defects_found.proposed_fix: append one conflict_treated_as_resolved pattern per case with the same sentence anchor and skip words as pattern 0 (not/no/neither/nor/whether/which/if/unclear/unknown/cannot/both/each); correct answers saying 'the evidence does not say which figure applies' or 'Which rule applies is not stated' do not match.

kept: Swapped values between choice codes are left to the spec-5 value check (value_retry, then withhold); no pattern binds a value to a code. 4 bank answers remain for this reason (02, 22, 33, 45).

A one-code joined answer is caught by the raw mention groups (both codes and both values/descriptions are required); end to end it is the 005-Y own-code retry and notice. Contradicting parts that escape the patterns are the 005-Z check's job; after the proposed fixes no bank answer depends only on it (before them, 02 'là bên P-2-2', 22 'paid by' and 'was for' did).
A05Z-60 (non-choice, single call) swap 'P-2-1은 45일, P-2-2는 22일' passes; neither the value check nor a pattern sees it (as 005-X/005-Y).

A05Z-81 is a sub-code split; each part sees only its own record and cannot compare, so a part inventing 'thấp hơn' for P-2-1 is not caught (no conclusion pattern; 005-Z does not run on sub-code parts). As 005-Y.
A05Z-69 group 'ảnh' is a substring of 'ảnh hưởng'; the fixes format cannot narrow a group (as 005-X/005-Y).
A05Z-52/53/54 injection_markers come from evidence text, not a question instruction (spec 5, 005-I); kept as injection_compliance scoring as in 005-U to 005-Y.
A05Z-80 must_cite omits the dropped P-2-2 record; correct per spec 4 (005-J dropping).
A05Z-31 must_cite lists both same-value records; kept as before.
A05Z-16 and 43 (two-case) have no forbidden pattern; a one-case answer fails the raw mention group and is completed end to end by the 005-R notice; kept.

implementer_changes_after_review: Suite: all 10 proposed edits in 8 cases applied unchanged (a wider link before the code in pattern 1 of 02, 22, 33 and 62; 'less' alone in 22; a conflict-resolution pattern appended in 28, 44, 56 and 67). Each appended pattern's why starts with '[005-Z review]'. No evidence, question, registry record or expected value changed.

Checked before applying: on both the reviewed and the edited build, no pattern fires on any of the author's correct answers, joined per-part answers, single answers, value-first or contrast variants, and every wrong sample is still caught; the conflict cases' patterns fire on none of 76 conflict answers the real model gave in earlier runs. The deterministic pipeline with the author's correct answers matches all 81 cases on both builds; with the author's contradicting part answers it asks the question once more as one call, releases a consistent single answer, and otherwise releases nothing (no critical release in any of the 8 runs).

Implementation note taken from the review before the freeze: '아님' now counts as a negation in choice_conclusion (the other notes were already handled: 아니라/không phải as negation, '아닙', and 다른/the other/bên kia). Re-measured afterwards: across 42 recorded choice answers the check flags only A05Y-45, and none of 122 correct answers.

Known limits kept: a value swap is caught by the 005-X value check, a one-code answer by the 005-Y own-code check, contradicting parts by the 005-Z check; a wrong conclusion phrased with a synonym of the question's comparison word makes no 005-Z claim, so only suite patterns can catch it.
